## Example bodyfat data

```{r}
library(readxl)
bodyfatdat <- read_excel("C:/Users/Pradeep Singh/Documents/Professional/CSDA5110/Fall_2024/Week6/bodyfat_data.xlsx")
View(bodyfatdat)
head(bodyfatdat)
```

## Regression Coefficients

```{r}
library(api2lm)

output_1 <- lm(bodyfat~triceps+thigh + midarm, bodyfatdat)
summary(output_1)
anova(output_1)



```
## Leverage

```{r}
library(api2lm)
library(stats)

output_1 <- lm(bodyfat~triceps+thigh + midarm, bodyfatdat)

influence.measures(output_1)
influence_plot(output_1)
plot(output_1, which = 4)
plot(output_1, which = 5)

```
